children.value: NYC’s Turkish Consulate (212-351-7200) is helping ship donations to those in need via Turkish Airlines. They are currently collecting in-kind donations at these three drop-off sites from 10am-9pm:
Portx, Inc. 256 Paterson Plank Road, NJ
Clearly marked packages in terms of quantity/content
Winter clothing (jackets, gloves, boots) + winter jackets for children
